title: Evaluation signalization and scale testing for embeddings + rerank sanity suite
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a reusable evaluation harness that ties golden embedding sets, offline metrics, and drift detectors together with a reranking-specific sanity test suite. The goal is a low-latency, scalable runner that produces signalized metrics consumable by Console and alerting pipelines. This ticket covers the runner skeleton, canonical golden set ingestion format, pairwise rerank checks, large-batch latency profiles, and initial integration with the telemetry pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: A harness binary (Python + lightweight worker) that can run offline eval jobs and emit standardized metrics JSON
Defined canonical golden set format and a storage loader for S3/Drive/GS-compatible URIs
Pairwise rerank tests that compute pairwise accuracy, MRR@k, and top-1 consistency for reranker variants
Baseline offline metrics computed for the current prod embedding and rerank endpoint within CI nightly runs
Drift hooks that compute population-level covariate shift and similarity-distribution drift and surface a summary metric to Console
Latency & throughput stress profile scripts that can simulate N concurrent embed/rerank requests and report p50/p95/p99 and token-level cost estimates
tasks: Design canonical golden set schema and metadata conventions (labels, seed, sampling)
Implement loader and validator for golden sets (S3 / Drive / local)
Add pairwise and listwise rerank validators (synthetic perturbation generator and oracle checks)
Wire offline metrics collector and formatter (precision@k, recall@k, mrr, ndcg variants)
Integrate drift calculation modules (KL, JS divergence for similarity histograms, PSI for population shift)
Create scale test driver using existing load harness; capture latency and batching behaviour
Publish metrics artifact to telemetry topic and add Console dashboard spec
Add CI job to run lightweight smoke harness on PRs and nightly full-run pipeline
comments: 2025-01-22: Kickoff sync with PM and Research. Agreed to reuse parts of the existing eval worker but move rerank checks into a separate module. (Aisha)

2025-01-30: Implemented loader + validator; validator flags schema mismatches and missing provenance. PR: github.com/redwood-inference/emb-eval/pull/129 (in review). Need security review for S3 access pattern. (Marcus)

2025-02-03: Added pairwise rerank test harness with synthetic swaps and tie cases to measure top-1 sensitivity. Early results show top-1 stability drops 4% when switching quantized model variant; flagged for dev team. (Eve Moreno)
2025-02-05: Telemetry hook PoC posts metrics to telemetry-dev topic. Next: map telemetry keys to Console dashboard and add alert threshold proposals. (Aisha)
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Synthetic perturbations may not reflect customer queries; Mitigation: curate a small customer-supplied holdout for higher-fidelity tests. Risk: Large-scale stress tests could consume heavy infra; Mitigation: run against a dedicated dev cluster with quotas and safe defaults.
notes: Avoid duplicating the existing embedding nightly runner; instead we will export a standardized metrics JSON that the Console ingestion pipeline can consume. Plan to iterate after two weekly runs and refine thresholds for drift alerts. Consider adding regression gating for Dedicated traffic in a follow-up ticket.
